name: lean-ctx
description: The LeanCTX cockpit (Select · Control · Prove sidebar, pulse line, turn and milestone overlays), colored ctx_patch diffs and highlighted ctx_read / ctx_search output, wake on background job completion, remove redundant lean-ctx hook context, shape native Bash output, keep core tools in front, and show per-session usage.

front_loaded_tools.title: Front-loaded lean-ctx tools
front_loaded_tools.description: Lean-ctx MCP tool names to keep in the prompt; all other lean-ctx tools stay deferred.

shape_native_output.title: Shape native Bash output
shape_native_output.description: Compress large native Bash stdout through lean-ctx (recoverable); off keeps it byte-for-byte.

cockpit_panel.title: Open the LeanCTX cockpit sidebar
cockpit_panel.description: Open the cockpit sidebar when a session starts. /cockpit off and /cockpit on change it; /cockpit opens it once either way.

color_output.title: Color lean-ctx output
color_output.description: Draw ctx_patch diffs with line numbers and colored markers, and ctx_read / ctx_search code syntax-highlighted. Display only: Claude receives the output unchanged.

cockpit_pulse_line.title: Show the LeanCTX pulse line
cockpit_pulse_line.description: Show the line above the prompt that follows lean-ctx calls while Claude works. /cockpit pulse off and /cockpit pulse on change it.

cockpit_turn_cards.title: Show LeanCTX turn and milestone cards
cockpit_turn_cards.description: Show a short card above the prompt when a turn ends or a milestone is reached. /cockpit cards off and /cockpit cards on change it; the sidebar keeps both.

wake_on_job_finish.title: Wake Claude when a lean-ctx background job finishes
wake_on_job_finish.description: Watch ctx_shell background jobs and start a turn when they finish (shown as a prompt from the lean-ctx plugin). Jobs finishing close together share one wake. Off: Claude checks a job's status itself.

keep_hook_context.title: Keep lean-ctx hook context
keep_hook_context.description: Keep lean-ctx SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit context from settings hooks.
